title: Scott Tan joins Rajah & Tann Singapore as Partner in International Arbitration
description: Scott Tan has joined Rajah & Tann Singapore as a Partner in International Arbitration practice.With deep experience in public international law, Tan has represented Singapore in various bilateral and multilateral trade, investment, and diplomatic negotiations - including the upgrade of the China–Singapore Free Trade Agreement (signed 2023) and the EFTA–Singapore Digital Economy Agreement (signed 2025) - and served as a delegate to the 78th session of the United Nations General Assembly.
